clips.title: The story
paras: Stormwind warlocks seek to bind a succubus to their will. Beneath The Slaughtered Lamb, an initiate uses the enchanted core from the Heartswood to summon the demon and defeat it in combat.

A crypt beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter shelters the city's warlocks. There, away from the city watch and the Cathedral of Light, they practice forbidden arts. Stone summoning circles channel the Nether's power and let initiates reach across the veil between worlds.

A warlock needs the prepared Heartswood Core to summon a succubus. The ritual opens a breach at the summoning circle, but the demon can corrupt and overwhelm even a fortified mind. To master it, the warlock must defeat it in single combat. Its physical form returns to the Twisting Nether, while its true tether is secured.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Using the heartswood core, you will be able to cast a spell at the summoning circle in the crypt below to open a portal for the succubus to pass through.
Be careful, friend, succubi have overrun even the strongest of minds.
Once you have bested and returned it to the void, return to me and I will show you how to call and control it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sometimes I wonder if Surena was not a succubus in disguise, sent to warp and twist my mind... Ha! I give her too much credit, I think.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, well done, friend. I see we've done right in deciding to train you. Your performance certainly does not disappoint.
I've no qualms in showing you the way to control your newly bound succubus. Observe carefully.
